mapper.select: select rac.PROD_ID prodId, rac.PUB_DATE pubDate, rac.ASSETS_CODE assetCode, rac.ASSETS_NAME assetName, rac.FAIR_VALUE fairValue, rac.PD_PROP pdDrop, rac.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, rac.UPDATE_USER updateUser from REP_ASSETS_COMB rac where rac.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rac.PUB_DATE = to_date(#{pubDate,jdbcType=DATE},'YYYY-MM-DD') and rac.ASSETS_CODE = #{assetCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: insert into REP_ASSETS_COMB (PROD_ID, PUB_DATE, ASSETS_CODE, ASSETS_NAME, FAIR_VALUE, PD_PROP, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, STATUS) values (#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{pubDate,jdbcType=DATE},#{assetCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{assetName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{fairValue,jdbcType=DECIMAL},#{pdDrop,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update:
update REP_ASSETS_COMB
ASSETS_NAME = #{assetName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
FAIR_VALUE = #{fairValue,jdbcType=DECIMAL},
PD_PROP = #{pdDrop,jdbcType=DECIMAL},
UPDATE_USER = #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
UPDATE_TIME = #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},
STATUS = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
where PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and PUB_DATE = #{pubDate,jdbcType=DATE} and ASSETS_CODE = #{assetCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT PROD_RE id, PROD_RE text FROM V_REP_PROD_INFO WHERE PROD_RE IS NOT NULL
SELECT PROD_ID id, PROD_NAME text, PROD_ABBR FROM V_REP_PROD_INFO
SELECT PROD_REGIST_NO id, PROD_REGIST_NO text FROM DIS_PROD_ADJUST
SELECT d.PROD_ID id, r.PROD_NAME text, r.PROD_ABBR FROM DIS_PROD_ADJUST d left join V_REP_PROD_INFO r on d.PROD_ID = r.PROD_ID

select distinct dp.BOOKSET_ID id, rp.PROD_NAME text from BOK_BALANCE dp left join V_REP_PROD_INFO rp on dp.BOOKSET_ID = rp.PROD_ID
and (BOOKSET_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or PROD_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))
(PROD_ID like concat(concat('%',#{item}),'%') or PROD_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{item}),'%'))

SELECT PROD_ID id, PROD_NAME text, PROD_NAME object FROM V_REP_PROD_INFO where REP_PROD_TYPE in ('02','01') and STATUS = 'E'
and (PROD_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or PROD_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))

select distinct bb.SUBJECT_NO id, bs.SUBJECT_NAME text from BOK_BALANCE bb left join BOK_SUBJECT bs on bb.SUBJECT_NO = bs.SUBJECT_NO where 1=1
and (bb.SUBJECT_NO like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or bs.SUBJECT_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))

SELECT PROD_ID id, PROD_NAME text, PROD_RE object FROM V_REP_PROD_INFO
status='E'
AND PROD_RE=#{prodRegistNo}
and (PROD_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or PROD_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))
union all SELECT P_PROD_ID id, PROD_NAME text, PROD_RE object FROM REP_PROD_INFO
status='E'
AND PROD_RE=#{prodRegistNo}
and (P_PROD_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or PROD_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))

select A.PROD_ID, A.ASSETS_CODE, to_char(A.PUB_DATE,'yyyy/mm/dd') pubDateStr from REP_ASSETS_COMB A
(#{item.prodId},#{item.assetCode},#{item.pubDateStr},'E')
